$comment: Read by scripts/dogeos-chain-list-guard.test.mjs (plan t23, spec section 6). A 46630 site without 6281971 within 3 lines passes only through an entry here. 'exceptions' may exclude 6281971 (an exception means 'may exclude'); 'categories' are the named exceptions of the plan's global constraints, plus 'plan-directed' for sites the plan or spec names explicitly, plus two categories for features merged in from release/evm-gen8 after the plan was written ('evm-gen8-v4', 'partner-api'). 'dogeosSiblings' are not exceptions: the 46630 line is Robinhood's own value, and the DogeOS branch for the same thing is a separate statement ('sibling', in 'siblingFile' or the same file), which the guard checks still exists. A pattern is a plain substring of the source line. Every entry must still match an uncovered site, or the guard fails it as stale.
